reviews.comment: Attendance required but in class she would not talk about anything relevant to the course. Tough grader but maybe I'm just bad at essays. She gives a lot of feedback which is nice. Light workload and then randomly got CRAZY 2-3 times over the semester. Research paper is so annoying. Its an okay class if you need it, but you'll be happy when it ends
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Pantuso is the professor that everyone should strive to be. She is such an inspiration, is so knowledgeable, and is completely understanding of your situation. Obviously put in the work, but if you have any issues, she'll work with you and help. I suggest everyone take her. You have to work, but she'll be your favorite, no doubt.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is amazing! Shes seriously the prof that brought me back from my COVID slump of being incredibly unmotivated and nearly failing classes when I had previously been a 4.0 student. I would highly recommend taking her! She is an angel.

I have a feeling she's one of those profs that are good in person, but not good online. She was going through a lot this semester so understandable. She's good at what she does, but her grading is very difficult and she expects a lot out of her students. Just make sure to invest time into EACH AND EVERY SINGLE assignment if you want a 100.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: No idea why this professor has such high ratings. She never gave feedback, had 8 assignments not graded the last week of school so I had no idea what my grade was, and she was never organized. It was when class went virtual for covid, but that's no excuse when other professors were able to keep up. My class had the lowest GPAs of every 104 class.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: one of the best professors at a&m. she cares so much about the success of her students and she is so helpful with assignments. her assignments are tedious, but are useful in the future.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Pantuso truly cares about students diving deep into topics that matter. She wants you to succeed but won't hand you an A unless you show her you're working hard. She will not teach you to write an essay, but she will tell you how to analyze and create an argument so be ready to critically think. Loved her!

Dr. Pantuso is absolutely amazing! She does everything that she can to help you pass the class, gives extra credit all the time, and the textbook is online for free through the University Writing Center. She takes attendance, but you are able to skip and still pass. I highly recommend her for any class available!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Pantuso is above reproach. She cares greatly about her students and their success (in)outside the classroom. If you provide her with great feedback by putting forth effort, in turn she will invest her time and effort in you. **The AGGIE TA's for the class: Staci and Monica were also exceptionally helpful and amazing.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great prof, essays took too long to write, so make sure to have plenty of time to write them and check with her for help.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really get to know her! She's great! In terms of her class, I hate English. But she made it bearable. The students who did poorly skipped class and seemed indifferent about participating. Make an effort to positively contribute and it will show in your grade. Go to the writing center for major essays. She likes to see progression from the drafts.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Pantuso is the most sweetest, caring, and genuine professor I stumbled upon my first year at A&M. You should be good if you put effort into writing your essays. TIP: Go to office hours, she gives great feedback on essays. Also, read the textbook, it gives great writing tips that can be useful in the future.

Shes really sweet so far and super interesting to talk to and get to know but man its taking a long time to get grades back and I wish I knew where I was at this point in the semester since we have another essay due in less than a week. But shes a great person and highly recommend her.

Dr. Pantuso was the best. The class was mostly based on essays, but there were some online assignments. She cancelled class a lot. She is a great Prof and I would for sure take her again. While going to class was pointless, she gave participation points. I would just go to class and work on something else. Loved her and would 100% recommend her.

Although she is the sweetest lady, she is not accessible outside of class and takes forever to email you back. She does not give feed back on your papers, so it's hard to know what you did wrong. She also does not teach really, going to class is a waste of time, even though attendance is mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Sweetest lady ever! Her class is a typical easy freshman class, would highly recommend taking her as a first semester freshman. She cares about your grade just as much as you do and will give you a ton of opportunities to get an A on papers (including allowing rewrites). She sounds kind of mean over email but is truly a very caring great teacher

I LOVED this professor, she is seriously the sweetest person. There are no exams, however, there are a lot of essays. She isnt to tough of a grader and she helps you when you need it. I would absolutely take her again and I definitely recommend taking her class.
